about:
Arizona Electrical Apparatus, Inc. was founded in 1996 in Tucson, Arizona, as a circuit breaker repair shop. The company is privately owned by Sal Gonzalez, who serves as president and owner, and has grown from a small repair operation into a multi-facility service and equipment provider.

Today AEA provides maintenance, testing, installation, and commissioning services for power distribution and motor control systems, and supplies apparatus such as switchgear, circuit breakers, transformers, relays, drives, and motor starters. It operates as an OEM and authorized distributor for major brands including ABB, GE, Eaton, Siemens, and Square D, and manufactures custom switchgear in-house. As of 2018 the company employed 55 people across three buildings totaling over 80,000 square feet of shop and warehouse space, with 25,000 square feet of warehouse inventory and five acres of outdoor transformer and switchgear storage.

AEA serves mining, utility, oil and gas, government and military, municipal, and ski resort customers. Its utility work includes staff augmentation and turn-key project execution for power generation facilities, while government contracts involve switchgear supply and onsite circuit breaker retrofits. The company also supports oil and gas operations with custom solutions to reduce downtime.

The company emphasizes a safety-first culture, ongoing employee safety training, and core values of teamwork, diversity, excellence, reliability, and customer service. Its stated mission is to safely and profitably provide mining and power distribution companies, large industries, and municipalities with quality power distribution and motor control products and services while maintaining a safe, efficient, and professional workplace.
